company.name: Charge Running
company.shortDescription: Charge Running is a mobile fitness app that provides interactive, trainer-led running classes, and live leaderboards.
company.description:
Charge allows you to stream and experience interactive, instructor-led running classes live from anywhere in the world! 

With competitive leaderboards and real time feedback from world class trainers, Charge is changing the way you run! It helps you connect with other runners from all over the world, get motivated with amazing trainers right in your ear, and it will bring out your competitive side to help push you farther than you thought possible. Can't make it to one of our live runs? Check out our "On-Demand" providing you with pre-recorded workouts to give you the Charge experience any time of day!

Charge is for those who frequent group fitness classes for spirited competition and motivation as well as value convenience, accessibility, and fun.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $125,000, or 15.63% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,186,048 to $6,780,450, a 5.72x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 29 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 51 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
